summary: CVR Energy (NYSE: CVI) filed an 8-K on June 23, 2026, disclosing the separation of President/CEO Mark A. Pytosh, effective June 18, 2026. Pytosh resigned from the board and his CEO roles at CVR Energy and CVR GP, general partner of CVR Partners (NYSE: UAN). He will receive a $3 million separation payment split into two equal lump sums: first within 15 days after release becomes irrevocable, second nine months later. He remains subject to post-employment obligations including a nine-month non-compete (reduced from 18 months) and a three-year standstill on strategic transactions. The board has not yet announced a permanent successor. Watch for CEO succession plans and potential strategic shifts at CVR Partners.
